sentence: It is also certain that South Sudan violated the sanctions regime by failing to take the measures necessary to prevent technical training of JEM in South Sudan and by failing to prevent JEM from transferring weapons into Darfur.

South Sudan has therefore certainly violated paragraph 8 of resolution 1556 (2004), read with paragraph 7 of resolution 1591 (2005), by failing to take the measures necessary to prevent technical training on and assistance relating to the provision of weapons to JEM in South Sudan from 2014 to 21 April 2015.

South Sudan has also certainly violated paragraph 7 of resolution 1556 (2004), read with paragraph 7 of resolution 1591 (2005), by failing to take the measures necessary to prevent the supply of weapons and ammunition by JEM to Darfur.
